messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired: PD-8241 — service=redwood-inference-frontend — symptom=5xx spike from sidecar workers (pool=dedicated-gpu-1) — severity=P1 — runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/sidecar-memory
owen: Acked in PD, I'm oncall and taking this. jumping onto bridge now. :phone:
maria: Thanks — can you confirm customer impact? which tenants seeing errors?
sre_ami: quick check from metrics: 5xx rate spiked at 12:13UTC, error-rate ~18% on route /v1/generate for pool dedicated-gpu-1. Top tenant ids: acct-927, acct-1023, partner-batch-job.
jess: Noted. Any recent deploys to sidecar or model variants in the last 30m?
sre_ami: No infra deploys recorded. Kubernetes shows sidecar containers restarting on nodes pool-dedicated-1-{a,b}. kernel log snippet:
```
[12:12:45] kubelet: container "sidecar-proxy" killed by OOM-KILLER
[12:12:46] docker: Restarting container for sidecar-proxy
[12:12:47] sidecar: mem usage growth from kv-cache and prefetch workers
```
owen: looks like sidecar OOM loop. I'm scaling down prefetch and bumping eviction threshold. running:
```
kubectl -n inference scale deploy/sidecar-prefetch --replicas=0
kubectl -n inference set env deploy/sidecar-proxy CACHE_EVICTION_POLICY=LRU
```
prod-eng: Can we also route a portion of traffic to fallback model variant r2025-quant while we stabilize? suggest 30% traffic shift to limit token pressure.
owen: doing a gradual 30% reroute to r2025-quant via routing-control. will monitor error rate and latency.
maria: I'll draft a short PSA to affected accounts (acct-927, acct-1023). cc'ing @customer-success to send direct notices if needed.
customer-success: on it — pinging both accounts now. keeping message brief: "We're investigating intermittent 5xx errors, minimal impact expected, we'll update within 30m."
jess: FYI toggled rollback flag for last model traffic optimizer change as precaution. no config redeploys yet.
sre_ami: after scale and reroute: 5xx down to ~6% within 5m, latency stable. still seeing 2 nodes with >80% memory in sidecar.
owen: I'll take node pool-dedicated-1-b offline for investigation (cordon + drain) and let autoscaler replace. initiating now.
maria: assigning follow-up ownership: owen will keep incident until sidecars healthy; once stable, maria + sre_ami will run a brief postmortem with timeline and mitigation steps.
owen: agreed. keeping page open until fully recovered. will post another update in ~15m or on change. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: PagerDuty note — acknowledged by owen at 12:17UTC. PD link: https://pagerduty/redwood/incidents/PD-8241
owen: update at 12:29UTC — node replacement complete, sidecar memory back to normal on replaced nodes, 5xx <1%. keeping monitoring window open for 30m.
maria: thanks all. I'll capture customer notifications and prepare postmortem draft once we confirm 30m clean window.
customer-success: customers acknowledged receipt, no major escalations so far.
owen: closing bridge once 30m clean. assigning postmortem owner: maria.
maria: noted, will own.
